summaryZh: Human Ecology Lab 探索人与环境随时间变化的关系，尤其关注气候变化相关的社会脆弱性。其研究强调与社区建立关系、提出社区相关的问题，并从过去知识中寻找当下气候问题的线索；负责人利用地质考古学、考古软体动物学，以及公民科学和社区考古合作开展研究。
methods: 地质考古学与考古软体动物学（负责人研究）
公民科学与社区考古合作（负责人社区研究实践）

evidence.quote: The Human Ecology Laboratory groups together students and researchers to explore the relationships between people and the environment through time. In particular, the lab focuses on understanding Social Vulnerability related to Climate Change.
Identifying community-relevant research questions Recovering past knowledge
Directs the SIO Human Ecology Laboratory.
Through geoarchaeology and archaeomalacology, Prof. Rivera-Collazo works to identify lessons from the past that are relevant to communities in the present.

evidence.quote: Rivera-Collazo works with the Borikua / Taino communities in Puerto Rico and the Tongva community of Catalina Island in California. Her work highlights the importance of building horizontal partnerships with indigenous communities through citizen science and communal archaeology.
